title: Picked for {name}
lead: To help Claude work better here, this installs working know-how (skills), automatic mistake checks (hooks) and project rules (CLAUDE.md). You can apply it as is.
tileSkillD: Ways of working Claude reads only when needed. Otherwise it keeps just each skill's name and one-line description.
tileHookD: Automatically stops Claude the moment it tries something risky. No judgment needed, so Claude doesn't read them.
tileHookC: 0 tokens normally · one line when blocking
tileRuleD: Short rules in CLAUDE.md that Claude reads every conversation. Existing text stays.
costLine: {word} · {pct}% of what Claude can hold at once
covTitle: 6 bars = which stages, from planning to shipping, get help
s2: How it helps while you build
s2p: Skills Claude pulls out at each stage · click a card to remove it
s3p: Automatic checks — free until they fire · click to toggle
s4p: The related checks follow your choice
s5p: Claude reads these every conversation · click to toggle
s6p: Write it down and Claude applies it after setup, then tells you what changed
notePh: e.g. Write commit messages in English. Run tests with npm test.
s7: What gets added to your project
s7p: Backed up first. Undo with one line if you change your mind
wMdD: Existing text stays; only a marked block is added
wManualD: {list} — license unclear, so not copied automatically. Claude helps you install after setup.
wNoteD: Claude reads and applies them after setup
freshLoading: Looking for repositories newer than the catalog…
freshNone: No new repositories over 1,000 stars since the catalog date ({date}).
freshError: Could not check for new repositories ({error}). Showing the saved list ({date}) only.
freshHint: Not vetted, so nothing is installed. Tick one and Claude reviews it after setup.
done: Go back to the terminal. Claude will summarize the result.
doneNote: Claude will also apply the requests you wrote.
doneFailed: Could not download: {list} — Claude will retry.
tileCostD: Tokens are the amount of text Claude reads. It reads this much at the start of every conversation. Less is faster and cheaper.
dPinnedV: Pinned to commit {sha} — you get exactly this even if the original changes later
dScriptsNote: When using this skill Claude may run these files. Each run goes through the usual permission prompt.
dPlugin: License unclear, so it is not copied automatically. After setup Claude helps you install it the original way.
dCost: {always} tokens always (name & description), ~{onUse} tokens when used (body)
flowNote: Checks adjusted to the branch strategy: {list}
hiddenOverlap: {n} skills that duplicate the "Block dangerous commands" check are hidden
shareD: When teammates open this repo in Claude Code, they are prompted to install find-your-skill (this tool). Once installed, the checks you picked apply to their Claude too. Until then the checks don't run on their machines.
wShareD: .claude/settings.json — existing settings kept, two entries added
wRequestD: .claude/fys-request.md — delete it after Claude applies it
wGitignoreD: keeps the backup folder (.claude/fys-backup/) out of commits
undoLine: Changed your mind? Type {cmd} in the Claude Code prompt to go back.
doneManual: Install yourself: {list} — Claude helps in the terminal.
doneUndo: Undo: type {cmd} in the Claude Code prompt
freshNoneShort: No new skills since the catalog date ({date})
switched: Switched to "{name}". Your manual edits were cleared.
dManualPin: This install method is not pinned; you get the latest version at install time.
rawNote: The original is in its repository's language (usually English).
addSub: {n} skills you can add · most GitHub stars first
confirmLead: Nothing changes until you press "Confirm and apply".
cSkillsWhat: Ways of working Claude reads when needed (instructions plus helper files). Each is downloaded at a pinned version into this folder.
cManualWhat: License unclear, so not copied automatically. After setup Claude walks you through installing them in the terminal.
cHooksWhat: The checker is the find-your-skill plugin you already installed. This file only lists which checks are on. Right before Claude runs a command or writes a file, it checks and blocks violations.
cRulesWhat: Project rules Claude reads at the start of every conversation. Existing text stays; only a marked block is added.
cShareWhat: When teammates open this repo in Claude Code they are prompted to install find-your-skill ({repo} {ref}). Existing settings stay.
cNoteWhat: Saves your requests. After setup Claude reads and applies them, then tells you what changed.
cExploreWhat: After setup Claude reads them and tells you whether they're worth using.
cBackupWhat: Saves the original of every file that changes (one .gitignore line keeps it out of commits). Used for undo.
stepsTitle: When you confirm, this happens in order
step1: Back up the files that will change
step2: Write the settings files and CLAUDE.md
step4: Go back to the terminal. Claude summarizes the result and continues with what's left (manual installs, your requests)
addSub2: Click a card to add it, click again to remove · most GitHub stars first
